definitions.explanation: The force that propels an object forward, especially in the context of engines, rockets, and aircraft.

examples.japanese: ⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{推力|すいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ロケット→ロケット：00353_roketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{推力|すいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。

⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧30⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧{推力|すいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}した→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: The new engine has 30 percent more thrust than the previous model.

notes:
Composed of {推|すい} (push forward) + {力|りょく} (force). A technical term used in aerospace, physics, and engineering. Commonly appears in news about rocket launches, aviation, and engine development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推力|すいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}させる→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: to generate thrust
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{推力|すいりょく}: maximum thrust
- {推力|すいりょく}⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧: insufficient thrust
- {推力|すいりょく}{重量比|じゅうりょうひ}: thrust-to-weight ratio

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推進力|すいしんりょく}→推進力：15905_suishinryoku⟧: propulsion; driving force — can be used both literally (physical propulsion) and figuratively (driving force behind a project)
- ⟦{馬力|ばりき}→馬力：14653_bariki⟧: horsepower — a unit measuring engine power output, not directly the forward force
- ⟦{水力|すいりょく}→水力：06434_suiryoku⟧: hydropower — a homophone with the same reading but different kanji ({水|すい} instead of {推|すい}), referring to the power of water
